title: .pagerduty.json
description: Links this repository to a PagerDuty service for the PagerDuty Incidents extension.

serviceId.description: PagerDuty service ID: the last part of the service's URL, e.g. PXXXXXX. Drives the status bar on-call display.

paths.description: Optional globs that scope commits and likely files to part of a monorepo, e.g. ["services/payments/**"].
